chainIdSource: require(block.chainid == CHAIN_ID) in setUp() and run(); CHAIN_ID = 1
intentComment: Story 072 THE PROMOTION-READY CUTOVER, extended by story 076 with Phase 4e (PhlimboV3 cutover + PhlimboV2 user-base migration). One differential mainnet broadcast promoting accumulated nft-staking (9611312) / yield-claim-nft (9c18020) / stable-yield-accumulator (6eab35c) work: (1) deploy NudgeStreamer and convert every donor from push-USDC to approve+collectNudge; (2) redeploy all four donor dispatchers (BalancerPoolerV2 idx4, Uniboost x3 idx1/2/3, NudgeRatchet idx7) plus a fresh StableYieldAccumulator; (3) replace BatchNFTMinter with BatchNFTMinterMultiToken (USDC/phUSD/Kendu whitelisted, registerStream 10/30/30 days); (4) silently migrate three NFTStakerDepletion instances to NFTStakerDepletionV2 via NFTStakerMigrator; (5) retire the old batch minter (setPauser(OWNER)+pause(), deliberately NOT registered with the global Pauser); (6) STORY 076 Phase 4e - deploy PhlimboV3 (phUSD + rewardToken + depletionDuration read LIVE off V2), two-step preview->commit APY, register with Pauser, GRANT phUSD mint authority, deploy MigratorV2V3, set migrator on BOTH sides, seed from the V2 snapshot and walk migrate() in chunks, then wind V2 down (setDesiredAPY(0) x2, setMigrator(0)) and revoke its phUSD mint authority. The five mint-debt hooks are REPOINTED, not redeployed. Story 072's 'ZERO phUSD.setMinter calls' invariant is now FALSE by design - there are exactly two - and the 'minter set byte-identical' claim is replaced by an ASSERTED TWO-SIDED DELTA in promotion-ready:verify.

snapshot.command: RPC_MAINNET=$RPC_MAINNET node scripts/snapshot-depletion-stakers.js && RPC_MAINNET=$RPC_MAINNET node scripts/snapshot-phlimbo-v2-stakers.js
snapshot.notes: The SECOND snapshot script is NEW in story 076 and is joined with '&&' so a failure in either halts the chain. PREREQUISITE for :dry / :broadcast / :resume - Phase 6 reads depletion-stakers-latest.json, Phase 4e seeds MigratorV2V3 from phlimbo-v2-snapshot-latest.json.

dry.command: node scripts/check-phlimbo-snapshot-age.js --variant v2 --fail-on-stale && PREVIEW_MODE=true forge script script/DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:DeployMainnetPromotionReady --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --slow -vvv
dry.notes: PREVIEW_MODE=true routes run() into vm.startPrank(OWNER) instead of vm.startBroadcast(), writes NO progress file, and ENABLES _phase8_previewSmokeTests() (blocking Kendu fee-on-transfer probe, MintPageView.getData(), per-dispatcher donation with positive BatchDonatedViaPSM, 40-mint batchMint after a warp, BatchMint__ArrayLengthMismatch negative test outside any broadcast block, BPT recovery). STORY 076: Phase 4e runs under the owner prank here, so the decoded UserMigrationSkipped reasons and the totalStaked()==0 completeness gate are exercised BEFORE any Ledger session; Phase 8 gains a PhlimboV3 stake -> warp 30d -> claim round trip and the SolvencyDetermination section-1 principal invariant.

broadcast.command: node scripts/check-phlimbo-snapshot-age.js --variant v2 --fail-on-stale && node scripts/backup-mainnet-addresses.js && forge script script/DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:DeployMainnetPromotionReady --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price 0.5gwei --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-promotion-ready.js && npm run promotion-ready:verify

post: npm run promotion-ready:verify (-> forge script script/VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol:VerifyPromotionReady, read-only)

flagRationale.--legacy + --with-gas-price 0.5gwei: story-071 lesson: forge's EIP-1559 maxFeePerGas dips below base fee during a long --slow Ledger session and geth rejects at eth_sendRawTransaction. With --legacy the gas price is the FLAT PRICE PAID, so it must stay a small multiple of base fee.
flagRationale.--gas-estimate-multiplier 200: story-073 lesson: under --slow each tx is a new block, so timestamp-dependent accrual does real SSTORE work the single-timestamp simulation never sees. Raises the gas LIMIT not the price; unused gas is refunded under --legacy.
flagRationale.--skip-simulation: removes the pre-send sanity check, NOT forge's local execution pass.

finalStateMutatingElementClaim.docKeyClaim: 'THE TRAILING && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-promotion-ready.js IS MANDATORY AND MUST BE THE FINAL STATE-MUTATING ELEMENT OF THE CHAIN - it is followed by the read-only npm run promotion-ready:verify leg (story 075) and by nothing else; never insert anything that writes between them.'
finalStateMutatingElementClaim.verification: The literal command string for promotion-ready:broadcast at HEAD b9391b1 is exactly [check-age] && [backup] && [forge] && [patch] && [npm run promotion-ready:verify]. Nothing was inserted between the patch step and the verify leg by story 076. promotion-ready:verify itself resolves to a single `forge script script/VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol:VerifyPromotionReady --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET -vvv` with no --broadcast, no --ledger and no trailing node step, and VerifyPromotionReady opens no broadcast context (source-level pinned by test/VerifyPromotionReadyGuards.t.sol). Story 076 DID change what the patcher writes (it now also fills the PhlimboV3 zero placeholder; the drift-guard key set moved 57 -> 58) but not its position in the chain.
finalStateMutatingElementClaim.residualObservation: The claim is about the npm chain only. It says nothing about a state write performed by the verify leg's own JS - there is none - nor about an operator running the chain a second time.

broadcast.notes: '&&' not ';' - the patcher must run only on a zero exit from forge script, because patching from a failed or partial broadcast writes addresses for contracts that may not exist. STORY 076: Phase 4e adds ~10-15 transactions plus one migrate() call per MIGRATE_CHUNK (25) users, each needing a Ledger signature.

resume.command: node scripts/check-phlimbo-snapshot-age.js --variant v2 --fail-on-stale && forge script script/DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:DeployMainnetPromotionReady --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price 0.5gwei --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-promotion-ready.js && npm run promotion-ready:verify
resume.differenceFromBroadcast: OMITS the leading `node scripts/backup-mainnet-addresses.js` (already taken by the crashed :broadcast run). Everything else is byte-identical.
resume.notes: Requires a HAND-TRIMMED progress file. The progress file is written during forge's LOCAL pass, BEFORE broadcasting, so after a crash it LIES about the `contracts` block. STORY 076 raised the protected baseline count from ONE to THREE: baselines.bptAtCutover, baselines.phusdMinterMask/phusdMintVersion, and baselines.phlimboV2StakedAtCutover. The top-level `baselines` block must NEVER be deleted or edited.

verify.notes: Read-only post-broadcast verification (story 075, script-audit run-22 M-01). Runs as a SEPARATE forge invocation AFTER the cutover settles, because forge executes the whole cutover body ONCE LOCALLY and dispatches afterwards - so Phase 0, every in-phase post-condition and all of _phase7_wiringAssertions() had already evaluated against PRE-broadcast state before tx #1 left the machine, and Phase 8's blocking probes are gated off under broadcast. It CONSUMES the write-once baselines and never re-derives them. Every check is a require, so any failure exits non-zero and halts the '&&' chain. Chained automatically at the tail of both :broadcast and :resume; also runnable standalone at will.

Phase 4d retire the old batch minter (RUNS AFTER Phase 5 by design)
